### ABOUT US

Inc42 is India's #1 startup media & intelligence platform, reaching over 25 million tech leaders and professionals monthly. Since our inception in January 2014, we have become the authoritative voice on India's startup economy, informing, educating, and empowering startup and business leaders through incisive reporting, insightful research, curated events, and industry-leading executive courses.

Our impact on the startup ecosystem is profound, with over 50,000 published stories, 100+ research reports, and 125+ conferences and events featuring thousands of entrepreneurs. Our reporting has moved markets, uncovered major transactions, and provided deep insights into the fastest-growing startups and industries. Our stories are regularly followed by global media outlets such as the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters, and TechCrunch.

Beyond media, Inc42 BrandLabs collaborates with leading enterprises to create impactful branded content and experiences, connecting them with a highly targeted audience of decision-makers. We also work closely with government bodies & state governments to support regional startup ecosystems through specialised reports and initiatives.

With Inc42 Datalabs, we track over 10,000 tech startups, and deliver market intelligence that drives strategic decision-making. Inc42 Plus, our exclusive membership program launched in 2020, provides tailored insights for business leaders, quickly growing to over 10,000 members.
